summary: Phase 2 e2e testing of JAZ Platform: 38/38 backend tests passed (auth, CRUD for employees/tasks/departments, employee task status+proof, attendance check-in/out with QR, reports with base64, performance metrics, admin companies+plans, owner subscription, Stripe checkout+status, and RBAC). Frontend forms for Owner Employees, Owner Tasks (with priority/due-date/assignee selects), and Employee Reports submit successfully. Navigation across Owner and Employee dashboards works.

minor.issue: TaskCreate has no server-side validation for allowed 'priority' values (high/medium/low) or valid assigned_to (any string accepted). Consider Pydantic Literal/enum for stricter validation.
Accepts raw dict without validating that status is one of TaskStatus values. Employee could set arbitrary status strings.
Both accept raw dict `updates` without whitelist -- clients could set role/company_id/password fields directly. Should filter allowed fields (as done in /api/employee/profile).
'Late' threshold hardcoded to 9 AM UTC; may misclassify due to timezone differences.

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for DialogContent (Radix a11y warning) -- add DialogDescription or aria-describedby for accessibility.

action_items: (Low priority) Tighten Pydantic models to use Literal/Enum for priority and status fields.
(Medium priority) Whitelist allowed fields in owner/employees PUT and admin/companies PUT to prevent role/company_id/password tampering.
(Low priority) Add DialogDescription to Dialog components to resolve Radix a11y warnings.
(Optional) Consider making 9 AM 'late' threshold configurable per company or timezone-aware.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has 1400+ lines - should be split into routers (auth, admin, owner, employee, payments) for maintainability.
Several PUT endpoints accept raw dicts (no Pydantic validation) which is a security risk - see minor issues above.
generate_qr_code is CPU-bound and blocks the async event loop when creating many companies; consider running via asyncio.to_thread.
Stripe webhook does not verify signature manually (relies on library) - ensure emergentintegrations validates Stripe-Signature header.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed is idempotent and seeds admin, owner, 2 employees, plan-001, company-001, 2 demo tasks, 1 department. Tests call it via autouse session fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest with conftest.py). All 38 tests pass. Frontend UI verified: owner login -> employees CRUD add works, tasks CRUD (with priority+assignee selects) works, employee login -> reports submission works, navigation to Performance and Tasks pages works. QR camera scan flow was intentionally skipped (browser permissions). Stripe checkout returns a valid Stripe URL; status endpoint accessible. RBAC enforced correctly on all owner/admin/employee endpoints.
